builtin.expectedEvidence: Operation-specific two-way contract between actual reference dispatch and generated wrapper, including rejection, errors and type parameters.

composition.expectedEvidence: Two-way composition from semantic loading and initialization through packet execution with the concrete target.

consumer.expectedEvidence: Checked whole-program packet property and rejection/drop family from exported source, actual initialization and concrete target contracts.

domain.expectedEvidence: Source-defined admitted inputs cover every legal constructor and parameter instance; establish every callee precondition on intermediate values.

extern.expectedEvidence: State the abstract extern correspondence and input/output invariant used by core certificates, without assuming a concrete implementation.

forward.expectedEvidence: Every terminating reference outcome has a related generated outcome; preserve failure kinds under the explicit input/environment contract.

initialization.expectedEvidence: Actual Nano initialization succeeds on admitted inputs and establishes HoldsSpec, guard, callback and environment assumptions.

observations.expectedEvidence: Preserve ordered packet bytes/ports, forward/drop, failures, persistent contexts and relevant fresh counters across packets.

printing.expectedEvidence: Preserve print_ byte results under the pinned hint environment and source provenance; canonical value equality alone is insufficient.

release.expectedEvidence: Recorded successful full local gate and exact-revision remote CI; these publication observations are separate from kernel proof evidence.

replay.expectedEvidence: Both Lean paths match the pinned upstream terminal outcome and required observations; missing data, timeout, unsupported and harness failures block.

representation.expectedEvidence: Prove source coverage, admitted generated-input validity and decoder sufficiency, including nested values and observation invariants.

reverse.expectedEvidence: Every terminating generated outcome has a finite related reference execution; preserve failure kinds without a fixed source-depth bound.

review.expectedEvidence: Independent review of release revision, source-domain adequacy, contract statements and remaining trust assumptions.

sensitivity.expectedEvidence: Discriminating mutations reject changed source, behavior, representation and observations at their intended checking boundaries.

soundness.expectedEvidence: Successful executable relation evaluation implies the logical relation.

sourceIdentity.expectedEvidence: Verify pinned source/export identity, fresh generated artifacts and quotations, accounting explicitly for erased fields and VarD.

target.expectedEvidence: Concrete pinned NanoSwitch port discharges abstract extern contracts through actual callbacks, including subsequent uses of returned values.

variable.expectedEvidence: Account for the source variable declaration and its type in the source domain and initialized environment; omission from quotations is explicit.
